description: Signals used by the deterministic document classifier. Keyword weights add evidence for a type; structural signals are computed from OCR layout (rows, dates, amounts). Keywords are matched case-insensitively with light fuzzy matching for OCR noise.

MEMBER_RECEIPT.label: Member Receipt
MEMBER_RECEIPT.description: Proof of one payment made by a member/flat to the society: bank acknowledgement (NEFT/RTGS/IMPS/UPI), cheque receipt or society receipt.

VENDOR_INVOICE.label: Vendor Invoice
VENDOR_INVOICE.description: A supplier's bill to the society for goods or services, usually with GST breakup.

PETTY_CASH_REGISTER.label: Petty Cash Register
PETTY_CASH_REGISTER.description: A cash book kept by the society office: cash received (withdrawals/imprest) and many small cash payments with voucher numbers and a running or closing balance.

CASH_BOOK.label: Cash Book
CASH_BOOK.description: Two-sided cash book with receipts (Dr) and payments (Cr) columns.

EXPENSE_REGISTER.label: Expense Register
EXPENSE_REGISTER.description: List of expenses without cash receipts or balances.

GENERAL_LEDGER.label: General Ledger
GENERAL_LEDGER.description: Account-wise ledger with debit/credit columns and running balance, usually system generated.

BANK_STATEMENT.label: Bank Statement
BANK_STATEMENT.description: Bank account statement with withdrawals, deposits and balance per transaction.

JOURNAL.label: Journal
JOURNAL.description: Journal entries with Dr/Cr accounts and narration.

PAYMENT_VOUCHER.label: Payment Voucher
PAYMENT_VOUCHER.description: One cash/bank payment authorised by the society, with payee and approval signatures.
